# WithTherapy

> AI-powered therapist matching platform connecting users with licensed mental health professionals for online and in-person therapy.

WithTherapy leverages artificial intelligence to help individuals find the right therapist based on their specific needs and preferences. The platform serves both therapy seekers and licensed therapists, offering comprehensive mental health resources and expert clinical insights from PhD-credentialed professionals.

## Key Topics

- AI-powered therapist matching
- Online therapy / Teletherapy
- Mental health resources
- Anxiety disorders
- Depression
- Bipolar disorders
- Therapist directory
- Therapy benefits
- HIPAA-compliant
- Appointment booking
- In-person therapy
- Mental wellness
- Therapist platform
- Matching system

## Core Platform

- [Looking to Find a Therapist? We're Listening.](https://withtherapy.com): WithTherapy homepage introducing AI-powered therapist matching platform
- [Find a Therapist, Psychologist, or Counselor Near You](https://withtherapy.com/therapists): Main therapist finder tool with AI matching system for online/in-person therapy
- [What We Do](https://withtherapy.com/what-we-do): Platform overview explaining WithTherapy's therapist matching features

## For Therapists

- [For Therapists](https://withtherapy.com/for-therapists): Therapist platform for practice management and AI-powered client acquisition

## Mental Health Education

- [Mental Health Resources](https://withtherapy.com/mental-health-resources): Knowledge base covering anxiety, depression, bipolar disorders, relationships
- [Therapist Insights](https://withtherapy.com/therapist-insights): Expert articles by PhD therapists on mental health education and clinical insights
- [Find a Therapist Near Me](https://withtherapy.com/therapist-insights/find-a-therapist): Guide on finding therapists and understanding therapy benefits for mental health
- [Online Therapy & Teletherapy](https://withtherapy.com/therapist-insights/online-therapy): Guide to HIPAA-compliant virtual therapy and teletherapy services
